stat_facts: Increases health and reduces chance to be dazed in combat (wiki Statistics; '1 STA = 1 HP' is marked 'need testing' there).
Increases melee and ranged weapon damage and shield block amounts; 1 STR = 2 weight (wiki Statistics).
Increases hit rate, weapon proc frequency and gives a channeling bonus to spellcasters (wiki Statistics).
Mana pool size if INT is higher than WIS, and offensive spell damage (wiki Statistics).
Mana pool size if WIS is higher than INT, and healing done; 4 mana per WIS point for WIS-based classes (wiki Statistics).
Merchant prices and charm break rate on paper; the wiki notes CHA did not seem to affect vendor prices in beta (May 2026).
class_mod: +2 STR, +3 DEX, +3 INT (wiki Spellblade Creation Guide)

mana.text: Your mana stat is whichever of INT or WIS is higher (wiki Statistics); 56 of 61 wiki Spellblade spells cost mana.
mana.label: FACT

builds.name: Infusion fighter (default)
builds.why: Spellblades are melee DPS who cast infusions and fields (official). INT is higher than WIS for every playable race here, so it is your mana and spell damage stat; STR and DEX for weapon hits.

builds.name: Melee-first
builds.why: If you mostly swing and use infusions for procs.

builds.name: Caster-first
builds.why: For field and discharge damage; 56 of 61 wiki spells have a mana cost.

build_caveat: Point totals are from the wiki race pages (10 bonus points for every listed race/class). Whether a stat has a per-point cap or diminishing returns at creation is not documented on the wiki: UNVERIFIED.

traits.why: Dexterous: +5% DEX and a 15-second +50% DEX burst for hit rate and procs.
Swordsman starts Slashing at 5 (+25%) with a Trainee's Scimitar. Evocation is the biggest Spellblade school on the wiki (20 of 61) if you prefer a school trait.
Forage finds food and drink in the field, so fewer vendor runs. Spellblades may take it. Infravision or Ultravision only if your race may take it (see the race note).

Miner starts Mining at 25 with a Trainee's Mining Pick and Pouch, matching the default gathering setup (Mining, Lumberjacking, Smelting) for early coin. Medic (Bind Wound 25 and bandages) is the safer pick if you expect downtime between fights. Blacksmith exists but smithing stays off by default here.

trait_caveat: Trait text and race/class limits are from Template:Traits; picks that your race cannot take are swapped automatically in the race note. Which trait is 'best' is STRATEGY; no sourced numbers compare them.
